text:
maria (support): Hi team — Verdant Labs hit us: they report two payments for the same renewal after they updated billing address and uploaded a PO. They have INV-2026-1023 (PO) and INV-2026-1024 (card) both showing paid. Customer wants the duplicate reversed. Payment IDs: pay_8f7a9c, pay_8f7a9d. Can billing confirm which one should be reversed?

raj (billing): On it. Can you paste the invoice PDFs or gateway txn IDs and the timestamps? last4 of card?

maria (support): Here are the details:

```
customer: Verdant Labs
PO number: PO-8812
INV-2026-1023 (created 2026-03-01) status: paid via PO (manual)
INV-2026-1024 (created 2026-03-01 02:14 UTC) status: paid via card
payments: pay_8f7a9c (PO apply), pay_8f7a9d (card charge)
card last4: 4242
billing address updated: 2026-02-28 23:50 UTC
notes from customer: "we uploaded the PO before renewal; expected autopay to skip card charge"
```

billing-bot: webhook events: 2026-03-01T02:13:50Z invoice.finalized inv=INV-2026-1024 id=evt_aa12; 2026-03-01T02:14:05Z payment.succeeded pay=pay_8f7a9d id=evt_bb34; 2026-03-01T02:14:06Z webhook.retry attempt=2 payload=invoice_sync idemp_key=null

noah (eng): Looks like our PO sync job ran and then a separate autopay flow charged the card. Webhook retry log shows idempotency header missing (idemp_key=null). I can reproduce locally by re-running the sync without idempotency:

```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.test/sync_invoice \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"invoice_id":"INV-2026-1024","source":"po_upload"}'
# result: creates invoice twice if idempotency header absent
```

raj (billing): Thanks @noah. Escalating to finance. @kevin (finance) can you prepare a refund for the card txn pay_8f7a9d and issue a credit note for INV-2026-1024 if needed? Customer prefers refund to original card. Amount showing: $12,450.

kevin (finance): I can process refund. Need GL code and a reason to include in the credit note. Once approved I'll issue refund rfd and create CN-2026-058. ETA 3-5 business days to settle back to card.

maria (support): Customer confirmed they want full refund to the card and then the PO to remain as the settled invoice. Reason: "duplicate charge after PO attachment". Approve refund.

kevin (finance): Processing now. refund_id: rfd_334455 created 2026-03-01T14:05Z. Created credit note CN-2026-058 referencing INV-2026-1024. Added internal note: duplicate charge after PO sync.

maria (support): Sent refund receipt to customer and confirmed they see refund pending on bank. Closing loop on support side.

noah (eng): I'll open a small fix PR to add idempotency header to PO sync job and add an integration test for webhook retry behavior. Tracking INF-8723.

olivia (support): :thumbsup: great coordination.

raj (billing): Marking ticket as billing-escalated -> finance-refunded. Please reopen if customer sees any additional charge. :eyes:
